result.instructions: Tools for Particle, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our devices are offline right now?"; "What is the current temperature reading from the device in the lobby?"; "Show me all devices in the Field Sensors product, newest connection first.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Particle data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run particle_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run particle_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run particle_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. particle_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: particle_get_user
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Show the signed-in Particle account: username, name, MFA status, and the Wi-Fi and cellular device counts that count against plan caps. Cheapest check that the access token works. Particle API: GET /v1/user.

tools.name: particle_get_access_token
tools.title: Get access token info
tools.description: Show the access token in use: when it expires (0 means it never expires), the client that created it, its scopes, and the orgs it can reach. Particle API: GET /v1/access_tokens/current.

tools.name: particle_list_devices
tools.title: List devices
tools.description: List the devices this account can see: claimed to it, or in a product it is on the team of. Newest handshake first, with online status, platform and product. Particle API: GET /v1/devices.

tools.name: particle_list_product_devices
tools.title: List product devices
tools.description: List the devices in one product, with paging and filters by ID, name, serial number or group. Default: 25 per page, newest connection first. Particle API: GET /v1/products/{product}/devices.

device_id.description: Only devices whose ID contains this text.

device_name.description: Only devices whose name contains this text.

serial_number.description: Only devices whose serial number contains this text.

groups.description: Comma-separated full group names to keep.

sort_attr.description: Attribute to sort by (default: last connection).

tools.name: particle_get_device
tools.title: Get device
tools.description: Get one device: name, owner, online status, last IP address, and the variables and functions it exposes. Particle API: GET /v1/devices/{device_id}.

product.description: Product ID or slug. Set it to use the product route for a device that belongs to a product you are on the team of.

tools.name: particle_get_device_variable
tools.title: Get device variable
tools.description: Read the current value of a variable that the device exposes. Particle API: GET /v1/devices/{device_id}/{variable_name}.

variable_name.description: Variable name, as the device exposes it.

product.description: Product ID or slug. Set it to use the product route for a device that belongs to a product you are on the team of.

tools.name: particle_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product: its ID, slug and name. Particle API: GET /v1/products/{product}.

tools.name: particle_call_function
tools.title: Call device function
tools.description: Call a function that the device exposes, with one optional text argument (max 63 characters). The device runs its own code, so the effect depends on the device. Returns the function's return value. Particle API: POST /v1/devices/{device_id}/{function_name}.

function_name.description: Function name, as the device exposes it.

arg.description: Text argument for the function (max 63 characters).

product.description: Product ID or slug. Set it to use the product route for a device that belongs to a product you are on the team of.

tools.name: particle_rename_device
tools.title: Rename device
tools.description: Set the name of a device. Renaming to the same name again changes nothing. Particle API: PUT /v1/devices/{device_id} with name.

product.description: Product ID or slug. Set it to use the product route for a device that belongs to a product you are on the team of.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Particle
prompts.description: What you can do with Particle here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_devices_that_are_offline
prompts.title: Find devices that are offline
prompts.description: List the devices your account can see, newest handshake first, with their online status. Filter one product's devices by name or serial number.

prompts.name: read_a_sensor_value_from_a_device
prompts.title: Read a sensor value from a device
prompts.description: Get one device to see the variables and functions it exposes. Read the current value of one variable, such as a temperature.

prompts.name: check_the_access_token_and_the_account
prompts.title: Check the access token and the account
prompts.description: Read the signed-in account and its device counts. Check when the access token expires and which scopes it has.

prompts.name: call_a_device_function
prompts.title: Call a device function
prompts.description: Call a function that the device exposes, with one optional text argument of up to 63 characters. The result depends on the device code.

prompts.name: rename_a_device
prompts.title: Rename a device
prompts.description: Set a new name for a device. Renaming a device to the same name changes nothing.
